Could we use quantile clipping on the numeric features?
Sure thing. Calibrating the output probabilities is on deck. Nothing failed on the last run. Managed to finish SHAP explanations for the top features.
Hyperparameter search over 200 trials is finished. We'll use MLflow for experiment tracking. Retries only apply to failed jobs. We keep getting non-determinism from an unseeded shuffle.
What about Polars instead of pandas for the feature pipeline?
Yep, doing that. We'll use XGBoost over a neural network for tabular data. Should we add more logging?
